name: Soul Puppet
source:
What happens when you wake up one morning and your loving mother looks like an eldritch horror?  That’s exactly what happened to Everett.  Having doubts in a town full of believers, he’s now the only one who can perceive the preternatural entities that surrounds them.  With his world view turned on its head and the only person he can confide in seemingly possessed, Everett is at the end of his rope.  What could turn his life around?  Meeting a nice girl, of course…

[From [url=https://bdoneart.itch.io/soul-puppet]itch.io[/url]]
